core.title: Keep each wagon at least as cohesive internally as coupled to any single neighbor wagon (advisory)
core.given: A wagon (at or above the min-graph-size guard) whose WMBTs, connected when they share >= min_shared salient object_of_control tokens, form one undirected graph with neighboring wagons' WMBTs
core.when: You author or revise the wagon's WMBTs, allocate WMBTs across wagons, or review existing wagons
core.then: Plan the wagon so its cohesion (intra-wagon WMBT edges) is >= its coupling (cross-wagon edges) to every single neighbor wagon; otherwise expect an advisory merge-suggestion signal.
prefer: When a wagon is more bound to one neighbor than to itself, treat the advisory merge-suggestion signal as a hint to consider merging it with that neighbor.
Judge cohesion and coupling on the same WMBT shared-token graph so the two counts are commensurable.
avoid: Treating the merge-suggestion finding as blocking or gating the plan — it is advisory only and never blocks.
Flagging wagons below the min-graph-size guard on account of separability.
Rewording object_of_control tokens merely to dodge shared-token edges instead of reconsidering the wagon boundary.
unless: The wagon is below the configured min-graph-size guard: it is skipped, not flagged.
core.why: A wagon should be a separable unit of work; if it is more bound to one neighbor than to itself, its boundary may be wrong, so the advisory signal suggests considering a merge with its tightest neighbor.
evidence: The wagon separability check's output shows no merge-suggestion advisory for the wagon, or the wagon is reported as skipped by the min-graph-size guard.
For a flagged wagon: cohesion(W) and max over neighbors N of coupling(W,N) counts from the single WMBT shared-token graph.
verification: Build one undirected graph over all WMBTs; an edge joins two WMBTs that share >= the configured min_shared of salient tokens taken from object_of_control.
cohesion(W) = number of intra-wagon edges; coupling(W,N) = number of cross-wagon edges between W and neighbor N.

Separable iff cohesion(W) >= max over neighbors N of coupling(W,N); non-separable wagons emit an ADVISORY merge-suggestion finding (the exact finding label and the emitting validator are realization details of this rule).
Cohesion and coupling must be measured on the same WMBT shared-token graph (commensurable).
Wagons below the min-graph-size guard are skipped, not flagged.
Token vocabulary, min_shared and the min-graph-size guard are config-driven calibration knobs owned by the realization's configuration; promotion to a strict disposition is deferred to calibration.
Disposition advisory, severity 2: the finding never blocks.

values: merge-suggestion advisory emitted by the wagon separability assessment

fires: A wagon meeting the min-graph-size guard has, on the single WMBT shared-token graph (edges = WMBT pairs sharing >= min_shared salient object_of_control tokens), fewer intra-wagon edges than the qualifying cross-wagon edges to some single neighbor wagon.
A corpus-wide separability assessment of existing wagons (no edit in progress) finds such a wagon and emits an advisory merge-suggestion finding.
doesNotFire: A wagon with fewer WMBTs than the configured min-graph-size guard (skipped, not flagged).
A wagon whose intra-wagon edge count is greater than or equal to its cross-wagon edge count with every single neighbor wagon (equality is separable).
Edits to code or tests that do not change wagons, WMBTs or their object_of_control.

neutralityNotes: The convention is essentially stack-neutral: it operates entirely on the ATDD plan corpus (wagons, WMBTs, object_of_control tokens), which is method vocabulary shared across stacks and already reflected in the profile vocabulary (layout.wagon_dir, layout.plan_item, urn.wmbt), so the core keeps those terms. Three realization-specific tokens could not be neutralized and are carried in bunOnly: the '[MERGE]' finding label and the exact finding id '[MERGE] wagon separability', the 'separability validator' naming, and the 'planner.wagon.*' configuration namespace for the calibration knobs. The knob values themselves (token vocabulary, min_shared, min-graph-size) are deliberately left unnamed numbers in the core: they are config-driven calibration owned by each realization's configuration, and promotion to a strict disposition is deferred to calibration, exactly as in the Bun text. The only profile dependency is which concrete artifact kinds play the wagon-manifest and WMBT-definition roles (roles.plan_artifact.kinds); no vocabulary key was missing, so proposedKeys is empty.
